newsitem.title: POLAND: KGHM tumbles again in profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: KGHM tumbles again in profit-taking.

text.p: Polish copper firm KGHM fell 9.7 percent in heavy trade to 19.5 zlotys on Tuesday but analysts said the stock could rise on Wednesday and then stabilise.
KGHM fell the daily maximum 10 percent on Monday on the back of its 2.1-percent gain on Friday and Thursday debut 11.9 percent above its 21-zloty institutional-investor issue price.
"The situation on the overall market has not helped KGHM...but the stock's falls over the past two days largely represent profit-taking," one trader said.
The Warsaw bourse's main index fell 2.3 percent on Tuesday and 2.4 percent on Monday as floods hit the country's south, where KGHM has said its output was unaffected.
